texts.zh: [From.GetName]在初步扫描后发现一艘全副武装的舰船正位于小行星带的轨道中，我们必须小心行事。
texts.en: Preliminary scans of [From.GetName] indicate that a heavily-armed vessel is in orbit of the asteroid. It would be wise to proceed with caution.

texts.zh: 在[From.GetName]轨道上发现的那艘全副武装的舰船是一艘被遗弃的军用舰船，名字叫“纳弗瑞的骄傲”。它的舰体十分轻盈、擅长闪避攻击，说明它是用来执行长途侦查任务的，但现在它被改装为了一个远程匿踪炸弹。从舰船的通讯记录中可知此船在袭击西万实验室的路上被某个叛军游击队截了下来，据说那个实验室中保存的威力强大的武器可以帮助游击队赢得战争胜利。我们从舰船的导航驱动器中找出了西万实验室的准确位置。
texts.en:
The armed vessel discovered in orbit of [From.GetName] is an abandoned military spacecraft called Nefri's Pride. Its light frame and evasion hardware suggest it was built for long-distance patrol missions, but it has since been retrofitted into a long-range stealth bomber.

Records of the ship's comms reveal it was hijacked by a rebel guerilla on its way to perform a strike against a secret complex called the Xvan labs, said to hold a weapon so powerful it could win them the war, when they were shot down. We have extracted the ship's destination from its navigational drive.

label.zh: 派一队科研考察队前往实验室。
label.en: Send a science crew to the lab.

label.zh: 我们并不需要这种武器。
label.en: We have no need for such a weapon.

texts.zh: 我们发现了用未知材料建成的金字塔型的隐藏建筑——西万实验室。这些实验室被层层的沙土所掩埋，在进行探索之前我们必须将覆盖这些设施的沙土清理干净，如果叛军们的推测没错的话，实验室中藏有威力强大的武器，绝对值得我们花大力气将其找出。
texts.en: We have located the Xvan Labs - a hidden gathering of pyramidic structures built from an unknown material, submerged under layers of sand and dust. We will have to excavate the facilities before we can explore them, but if the rebels were correct in their assumptions, the weapons within will be worth their while.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家们从西万实验室安全归来并带回了实验室安保摄像头中的视频记录，视频中记录了如下场景：实验室科学家们被游击队士兵捆绑起来、游击队士兵试图打开武器箱，但发现里面空空如也。

几分钟后，叛军士兵们突然痛苦的倒地，他们身体上出现黑色斑点，然后灰色不明物质从他们体内钻出。

那些灰色物质不断膨胀，并围绕着他们旋转，其中一名实验室科学家启动了紧急系统，房间的洒水器开始喷水，然后电流经由洒水器让房间内所有的生物统统触电，然后视频记录就终止了。我们的科研队经过确认，发现武器箱确实是空的。
texts.en:
Our scientists have returned from the Xvan labs unscathed with footage collected from the facility's security cameras. It shows lab scientists bound and gagged as guerilla soldiers pry open the weapon strongbox. But to their dismay, the box is empty.

Only minutes later the rebels can be seen writhing on the floor in intense agony, dark patches swelling across their bodies, then their skin rips and a gray unidentifiable matter spills out.

The matter continues to expand, swirling hypnotically around them, until one of the scientists activates the emergency system. Sprinklers douse the room in liquid and an electrical surge passes through it executing all living things. Here the footage ends. Our crew can confirm that the strong box was indeed empty.

tooltips.zh: 我们对西万研究室的考察让我们的工程学研究技术取得了进一步发展。
tooltips.en: Our excursion into the Xvan labs has progressed our engineering research.

summary.text:
# 武装舰船 / Armed Vessel

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1470-1496; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:6783 (distar.2040); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:1426 (INVISIBLE_DEATH); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:6839 (distar.2041)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。小行星可能生成（3级，权重3，全局一次）；帝国正在进行L星团事件链且尚未集齐线索时权重×2。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on asteroids (level 3, weight 3, once per game); ×2 while the empire runs the L-Cluster chain without completing it.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

distar.2040“纳弗瑞的骄傲”：一艘被叛军劫持改装的隐形轰炸机，原本要袭击据说藏有决胜武器的西万实验室，途中被击落。派科研队前往 → 在可到达的小行星上开启 INVISIBLE_DEATH（140天）→ distar.2041“看不见的死亡”：监控录像显示叛军打开空无一物的保险箱后被体内涌出的灰色物质吞噬，科学家启动应急系统电死了所有人。奖励工程学研究并设置 lcluster_clue_desc_3。不需要 → 影响力。结果执行 pop_lcluster_event：若已遇到首座L星门且线索未集齐，有30%几率在10天后触发通用的 distar.9000“L星门见解”（另一故事）。

distar.2040 "Nefri's Pride": a patrol craft hijacked by rebels and refitted as a stealth bomber, shot down on its way to strike the Xvan Labs, said to hold a war-winning weapon. Send a team → INVISIBLE_DEATH (140 days) on a reachable asteroid → distar.2041 "Invisible Death": security footage shows the rebels opening an empty strongbox, then grey matter bursting out of their bodies until a scientist electrocutes the room. Engineering research; sets lcluster_clue_desc_3. Decline → influence. The result runs pop_lcluster_event: if the empire has met its first L-Gate and the clues are incomplete, there is a 30% chance of the generic distar.9000 "L-Gate Insights" 10 days later (a separate story).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

派队或放弃。

Send a team or decline.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

已核对异常、distar.2040–2041 与项目。树结构正确。30天后的通用接触报告 story.5 是共享事件，不属于本故事。

Checked the anomaly, distar.2040–2041 and the project. Tree correct. The generic contact report story.5 30 days later is a shared helper, not part of this story.
